_snapshot: PROPOSED — not yet created in n8n. Hourly reconciliation sweep over iClosed's contacts API. Two jobs: (1) catch abandoned leads whose webhook delivery was dropped — webhooks are forward-only and best-effort, and iClosed does not sign or guarantee them; (2) BACKFILL every abandoned lead already sitting in the iClosed account, which the webhook can never reach because it only fires going forward. Nobody has counted that pool yet. IMPORTANT: rows land as status='backfilled', NOT 'pending', so the dispatcher ignores them. Emailing a whole back catalogue of cold leads the moment this switches on is a decision for Sidney, not a side effect of a reconciler — see README.md §10. Promote them deliberately with a one-off status update once he has seen the count. BEFORE IMPORT: an iClosed API key is required (Settings -> Developer -> API Keys, shown once) as an n8n Header Auth credential sending `Authorization: Bearer iclosed_<key>`. The base URL and query parameters below are taken from iClosed's API docs and are UNVERIFIED against this account — run it manually once and read the output before scheduling it.
name: Sales — Booking Recovery Sweep (iClosed)

nodes.name: Fetch iClosed Contacts
nodes.notes: Needs a Header Auth credential sending `Authorization: Bearer iclosed_<key>`. Never hardcode the key in this node — several existing workflows have API keys pasted into code nodes (CLIENT_LIFECYCLE_MAP.md §15.6) and that pile should not grow.

nodes.name: Upsert Backfill Row
nodes.notes: Upsert on lead_key. Idempotent: re-running the sweep cannot duplicate a lead, and cannot revive one the dispatcher already handled — only rows that do not exist are created, and existing rows keep their own status.
